audit.why: 55.91% over 2200 games, FAV, 6/10 — matches a lane Olaf owns from 2 to 5 and again after 6 has been baited.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers show Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill — five neutral rows in a row on a 55.91% matchup, contradicting the packet chart, the mirror audit, and the whys printed beneath them.
audit.why: The whys already name Morde's level-2 Death's Grasp spike, Olaf's level 2-3 punish, Olaf's 4-5 slow chain, Morde's level-6 Realm of Death swing, and Olaf's item windows. Only the side tokens disagreed.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped as one atomic group in both layers to Olaf, Mordekaiser, Olaf, Olaf, Mordekaiser, Olaf, Olaf, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never names a single Mordekaiser ability except Realm of Death, and calls Ragnarok a blanket answer to it ('once you press R, nothing he has stops the run-down'). Realm of Death is a banish that relocates both champions; Ragnarok grants immunity to disables, which is not the same thing.
audit.why: A player who reads 'nothing he has stops the run-down' will press R into his ult and still get dragged, having spent a 100s cooldown for nothing. Riot's text for Ragnarok is explicit: immune to disables while he keeps attacking.
audit.corrected: Realm of Death stated as a 140/120/100s banish Ragnarok does not prevent. Death's Grasp named as the 700-range pull at 16s rank 1, Obliterate as the 675-range slam that hits harder on a single target, Indestructible as the store-and-heal shield that makes Executioner's Calling a real timing. Reckless Swing's true damage stated as ignoring the MR he builds.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Realm of Death' with no number anywhere in the page.
audit.why: 140s at rank 1 is the single longest cooldown in the lane and the whole plan hangs on it; Death's Grasp at 16s is the one that decides individual trades.
audit.corrected: Both durations written into the cooldown breakdown and the all-in window.

audit.why: Executioner's Calling is already called out against Indestructible's heal, and Mercury's Treads/MR is right into a full-AP Morde.
audit.corrected: No change; reinforced the anti-heal timing in phases[5].why.

edits.before: Build MR — true-damage him and out-brawl his realm. Olaf wins by trading around Mordekaiser's Realm of Death and cashing the pattern: build MR and out-brawl his realm.

edits.before: Build MR and out-brawl his realm. Track Realm of Death before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Punish levels 2-5 with Undertow into Reckless Swing, build MR, and never sit low in his R range at 6.

edits.before: Mordekaiser wins by landing Realm of Death, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Mordekaiser wins by pulling with Death's Grasp into an isolated Obliterate, then scaling behind Indestructible.

edits.before: Axe-slow + W sustain wins the first trades. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Morde's level 1 is feeble — Undertow's slow plus an auto wins first contact, and your passive ramps as you take chip.

edits.before: E true damage on cooldown is free, armor-proof chip. Only take the trade when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: At 2 Death's Grasp pulls you in for an isolated Obliterate plus Indestructible — that combo flips a sloppy trade.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Mordekaiser must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Undertow to stick him, then Reckless Swing true damage that Indestructible's shield cannot soak — your hardest punish.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Realm of Death's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Axe pickups reset Undertow off its 9s, so chained slows keep him from ever landing an isolated Obliterate. Bank plates here.

edits.before: Ragnarok deletes CC — once you press R, nothing he has stops the run-down. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mordekaiser's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Ragnarok clears disables but not a banish — Realm of Death still takes you. It is a 140s cooldown: bait it out, then own the next two minutes.

edits.before: Sundered Sky is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Realm of Death's cooldown.
edits.after: Sundered Sky plus Executioner's beats Indestructible's heal — force every fight while R is down.

edits.after: Your slows and true damage still win the side-lane 1v1 on his R cooldown, but he scales — close before full build decides.

edits.before: His 1v1 realm. Out-brawl it with E + W. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.after: Realm of Death is a banish, not a disable — Ragnarok does not stop it. Reckless Swing's true damage ignores his MR.

notes: The one dangerous claim on this page was phases[4].why telling the player that after pressing Ragnarok 'nothing he has stops the run-down' — Realm of Death is a banish and Ragnarok's immunity is to disables, so that line loses games. Rewritten around baiting the 140s cooldown instead. The content layer's slot naming was already correct (verified against the kit), so it needed only the chart flip and the banish wording. KIT FLAG MISFIRE, same as the mirror recorded: olaf.json tags Undertow with grounding, but Riot's description is damage plus Armor and Move Speed reduction only — no grounding claim written anywhere.
